description: Temperature-scaled KL from fixed teacher logits to student logits, summed over classes per example and multiplied by T^2. The softened distributions follow Hinton et al. §2 Eq. (1), and the T^2 scaling follows §2's soft-target gradient discussion and §2.1 Eq. (2); structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50. This is distinct from decoupled target/non-target KL in src/topologies/implementations/losses/dkd.py:59-103.

examples.title: Train a student to match softened teacher logits

name: Student-Teacher Knowledge Distillation KL Loss

parameters.additional parameters: temperature is the only accepted parameter in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because targets are teacher logits, not class indices
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point student logits shaped [B,C] with B > 0 and C >= 2
parameters.reduction: none returns one KL value per example, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point teacher logits with the same [B,C] shape, dtype, and device; detached as fixed soft targets
parameters.temperature: finite positive real scalar applied to both logits before softmax; per-example KL is multiplied by its square (default 1.0)
